Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph s. z02L OPINION NO. 29 08 2024 HON. TRISHA MAE A. CRUZ, ET AL. Sangguniang Kabataan Member Barangay San Bartolome Quezon City Dear SK Member Cruz et al: This is with reference to your earlier letter seeking clarification on the interpretation of certain provisions of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2023 167, entitled "Amendment to Certain Provisions of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2018-131 dated August 15, 2018 Relative to the Guidelines on the Appointment of Sangguniang Kabataan Secretary (SK) Secretary and Treasurer." Specifically, you want to be clarified on the following: 1. Whether the concurrence of SK Members is discretionary or ministerial in the event that an appointee for SK Secretary or SK Treasurer has been found to meet the qualifications under Section 10 of Republic Act No. 10742 and Item 4.1 of DILG MC No. 2023-167? 2. Whether the SK Members can consider criteria other than the qualifications set under Section IO of Republic Act No. 10742 germane to the office of the SK Secretary and SK Treasurer, such as professional experience? For your first query, we examine Section 7 of Republic Act No. 10742, otherwise known as the "Sangguniang Kabataan [SKI Reform Act of 2015," as amended by RA No. 11768, viz: SEC. 7. Creation and Election of the Sangguniang Kabataan. — There shall be in every barangay a Sangguniang Kabataan to be composed of a chairperson and seven (7) members who shall be elected by the registered voters of the Katipunan ng Kabataan. The Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson shall, with the concurrence of the majority of the Sangguniang Kabataan members, appoint from among the members of the Katipunan ng Kabataan, a secretary and a treasurer. It being emphasized herein that the aforequoted provision uses the word "shall" vis- a-vis the power of the SK Chairperson to appoint from among the members of the Katipunan ng Kabataan, a secretary and a treasurer. The word "shall" indicate a word of command, and one which has or which must be given a compulsory meaning, and "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

it is generally imperative or mandatory.l On the other hand, the power given to the majority of the Sangguniang Kabataan members to concur such appointment of the SK Chairperson is to be construed as an act confirming that the appointees to the positions of secretary and treasurer possess all the qualifications and none of the disqualifications as provided under existing laws such as RA 10742 an relevant by DILG issuances such as DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2018-131 as amen MC No. 2023-167. Of recent, please be informed that DILG MC No. 2023-167 is further amended by DILG MC No. 2024-013, a copy of which is available in dilg.gov.ph. Hence, if the appointee possesses all the qualifications and none of the disqualifications as mandated by pertinent laws, the majority of the Sangguniang Kabataan members has no discretion to deny the concurrence. With reference to the 2nd query, please be apprised that RA No. 117682 requires that SK Treasurers must possess an educational or career background relating to business administration, accountancy, finance, economics, or bookkeeping. We quote the full text of Section IO of RA 10742, as amended by RA No. 11768, which provides: "SEC. 10. Qualifications. — An elected or appointed official of the Sangguniang Kabataan must be a citizen of the Philippines, a qualified voter of the Katipunan ng Kabataan, a resident of the barangay for not less than one (1) year immediately preceding the day of the elections, at least eighteen (18) years but not more than twenty-four (24) years of age on the day of the elections, able to read and write Filipino, English, or the local dialect, must not be related within the second civil degree of consanguinity or affinity to any incumbent elected national official, or to any incumbent elected regional, provincial, city, municipal or barangay official, in the locality where the appointive or elective official seeks to be elected, and must not have been convicted by final judgement of any crime involving moral turpitude. Provided, That the Sangguniang Kabataan treasurer and secretary must be at least eighteen (18) years of age but not more than thirty (30) years of age on the day of appointment. Provided, further, That the Sanggunianq Kabataan Chairperson shall apooint a treasurer with an educational or career backqround relatinq to business administration, accountancy. finance. economics. or bookkeepinq. Provided further. that only if no person meets the requirements can the Sanqqunianq Kabataan Chairperson consider other suitable nominees. We emphasize the use of the disjunctive term "or" which denotes a notion of separation of the words "educational" and "career". Manifest, therefore, is the intention that these two qualifications, i.e., educational background and career background, are in the alternative. 1 UCPB GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY, INC. v. Lastly, it is equally important to emphasize that the need to have an educational or career backgroundfbusiness administration, accountancy, finance, economics, or / bookkeeping is prescribed for SK Treasurers only, but not for SK Secretaries. To know more about the guidelines on the appointment of SK Secretary and Treasurer, we invite you to read DILG MC No. 2024-013, a copy of which is available in *lg.gov.ph. This Opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you.
